author: /root/next_auth_context design; /root test and driver

decision.retention: Approve refinement superseding duplicate AppState field. AuthRestState owns private Option<PgPool>; existing AppState ownership and router clones retain same actual pool. Preserve legacy business pool and existing constructor signatures. Builder and immediate readyz accessor have actual consumers.
decision.admission: AppState::from_config is the actual API/configured-business/enabled-auth admission point before background work. Reuse connect_command_pool for existing authenticated-role/reset/timeout checks. Fixed AUTH_DATABASE_URL errors must not stringify secret-bearing driver details.
decision.readiness: Reuse readiness_dependency_status with existing DatabaseDependency view and require configured AND ready for required auth. NotConfigured.healthy() alone is insufficient. Preserve nonrequired mode behavior. No response schema expansion required.
decision.target_check: Approve equality of live current_database/name, pg_database OID, non-null inet_server_addr and inet_server_port as same-observed-target STARTUP check only; errors/null/difference refuse. This intentionally preserves aliases reaching the same reported endpoint while refusing some valid alternate endpoints.

adversarial_limits.finding: Endpoint/name/OID is not globally unique physical authority. Independent cloned clusters can share private server address, port, database name and OID. Proxy/NAT routing can hide distinct upstreams.
adversarial_limits.disposition: Accepted bounded limitation only. Do not describe equality as proof of physical same database or tenant/fence authorization.

adversarial_limits.finding: Startup metadata readback does not bind later pool reconnects, prevent DNS/proxy retargeting, or prove primary status, timeline, replay freshness or serving generation. SELECT 1 readiness only proves transport availability.
adversarial_limits.disposition: Explicit HOLD for actual authoritative fence-consumer and production topology/HA guarantee. No migration/privilege/nonce mechanism added merely to overclaim this lane.

adversarial_limits.finding: Same logical database accessed through IPv4/IPv6/listener differences can report unequal server addresses.
adversarial_limits.disposition: Intentional fail-closed support boundary; deployment must use admitted compatible routing. Do not claim arbitrary alias/proxy support.

adversarial_limits.finding: AppState::new remains synchronous composition and can construct enabled auth with missing retained pool.
adversarial_limits.disposition: Required-mode readyz must return503; production entrypoint remains from_config. No claim every synthetic constructor independently admits serving credentials.

test_review.assessment: Readiness regression has genuine healthy startup, retained session witness, auth-only NOLOGIN plus exact backend termination, SQLSTATE28000 positive fault witness, all other serving-role controls and exact custody verdict,503 on same router, full role restoration and200 recovery on same state. Stronger than presence-only field assertions.
conditions: Use exclusively owned disposable cluster with serial filter; cluster-global role mutation must never target shared cluster. Existing reviewed driver retains this setup.
Inspect actual4 discovered/executed cases and failure location; selected filter is not itself a count oracle.
Test does not cover missing-required-pool, reconnect target changes, authority freshness, session fencing, field policy or HA. Preserve existing mode/parser/identity tests as regressions.
Panic restoration is present; process death is contained by disposable cluster cleanup, not guaranteed SQL restoration.

driver_review.unchanged: Filter, serial runner, pinned image,4GiB tmpfs, actual source snapshot, cleanup and Cargo behavior byte-preserved. No services executed by reviewer.

smallest_fit_alternatives.chosen: Single retained auth pool in AuthRestState using existing connect and readiness helpers.
rejected: Duplicate AppState.auth_database retention creates needless state synchronization.
Raw DSN string equality conflates deliberately different credentials and host spellings.
Name/OID alone is weaker than observed endpoint comparison.
New pg_control_system grants, nonce tables or advisory handshake exceed bounded lane and still require authority/topology design.

remaining_holds: Actual Account fence request-context/prewrite activation requires its own meaningful RED and authority review.
Physical cluster/serving generation/restore/failover/current-authority and production exposure remain unproved.
Behavioral RED/GREEN and actual counts must be supplied by root run.
